reported_status: A FIXED causal feedback program using at mostH planned Bernoulli(theta)bits has an EXACT POSITIVE BERNSTEIN response family p(theta)=sum_n binom(H,n)theta^n(1-theta)^(H-n)q_n. Each unknownq_n is acquired by an EXECUTABLE uniform fixed-count seed experiment,not a supplied hidden-model oracle. Finite noisy records give a simultaneous confidence band over the CONTINUUM of theta and recorded deadlines,certified DATA-SELECTED use and a separate deterministic HIGH-COMMAND DURATION cap. This closes a restricted finite-acquisition task without hidden-state reconstruction. The correct JOINT LATENT LIKELIHOOD comparator is substantially more accurate on the synthetic example;ordinary saturated likelihood on the same reduction equals the direct estimator. No laboratory validation or general efficiency/universal-controller claim.
